# The optimizer splices a component body into its caller when a prop it was
# handed folds, and the call site dissolves there: an event the body fires runs
# the handler that call site wrote, or nothing where it wrote none. Left
# standing, the emit fired an event the caller does not declare -- a test's
# harness makes the component under test the root, nothing splices it later,
# and the Go called an `emit` nothing declares (the showcase's `undefined: emit`
# on fyne) -- or, where the caller declared one of the name, ran the caller's
# handler in place of the one written for the call.

sngl generate --platform fyne --lang go --opt rootComponent=main --out out app.sngl
! grep 'emit\(' out/model.go
grep 'm.taps = \(m.taps \+ 1\)' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

component main ui.node {
    var taps = 0
    ui.avatar(initials="JD")
    ui.avatar(initials="AB", @click { taps = taps + 1 })
}

ui.window {
    main
}
